description: Publish Markdown to PostMD and get a shareable web page
name: io.github.reinlainer/postmd-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: Where PostMD runs. Defaults to https://postmd.turink.com; set it only for a self-hosted instance.
environmentVariables.name: POSTMD_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Needed only for managing documents, attachments and groups. Publishing and reading work without it.
environmentVariables.name: POSTMD_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for verbose diagnostics on stderr.
environmentVariables.name: POSTMD_DEBUG
